data.desc: Based in Malaysia, WF Holding Limited is an ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturer of fiberglass reinforced plastic ("FRP") products including tanks, pipes, ducts and custom-made FRP products. With a track record of over 30 years, the Company designs and fabricates products that meet the specific needs of its clients, ensuring high-quality and reliable performance. The Company's high-quality and durable products leverage the advantages of FRP to reinforce critical industrial infrastructure, driving resilience, longevity and sustainability. The Company also delivers a wide range of related services such as consultation, delivery, installation, repair and maintenance.
